article.title: Useful phrases for starting a meeting
article.description: Common professional openers: 'Shall we get started?', 'Let's dive right in.', 'Thanks everyone for making the time.', 'I'd like to run through today's agenda.' Register: professional but not overly formal — appropriate for most workplace meetings. Avoid overly casual openers like 'What's up guys' in a professional context.
article.content: Common professional openers: 'Shall we get started?', 'Let's dive right in.', 'Thanks everyone for making the time.', 'I'd like to run through today's agenda.' Register: professional but not overly formal — appropriate for most workplace meetings. Avoid overly casual openers like 'What's up guys' in a professional context.

generated.caption:
Ever wonder how to start a meeting professionally? 🤔 Setting the right tone is key!

For most workplace meetings, use phrases that are professional but not too formal. Avoid overly casual greetings like "What's up guys?" Try "Shall we get started?" or "Let's dive right in."

Save this for your next meeting! Follow @TheEnglishVault for daily English lessons!
generated.script:
Interview mein ya office meeting mein, 'What's up guys' bol ke shuru mat karna! Professional meetings mein shuruat kaise karein, ye confusion hota hai na?

Dekho, professional meetings mein ye casual openers jaise 'What's up guys' bilkul avoid karna chahiye. Instead, you can say: 'Shall we get started?' ya fir 'Let's dive right in.' Agar sab time pe aaye hain toh, 'Thanks everyone for making the time' bol sakte ho. Aur agar agenda discuss karna hai, toh you can say, 'I'd like to run through today's agenda.' Ye phrases professional hain but overly formal bhi nahi.

Toh ab samajh aaya? Meeting ki shuruat always professional phrases se karo, impression accha padega. No more 'what's up guys'!

Comment karke batao aapko ye phrases pata the ya nahi! Aur save kar lo agle meeting ke liye! Follow The English Vault for more such tips!

slides.body: Starting a meeting effectively sets a professional tone. Phrases like 'Shall we get started?', 'Let's dive right in.', 'Thanks everyone for making the time.', and 'I'd like to run through today's agenda.' are excellent choices for most workplace discussions. These openers strike a balance, being professional without being overly formal. Remember to avoid overly casual greetings such as 'What's up guys?' in a business context, as they are generally inappropriate for professional settings and can undermine your message.
